feed.title: Equifax Launches AI-based Synthetic Identity Fraud Detection as More Companies Turn to AI
feed.summary: Equifax has introduced "Synthetic Identity Risk," an AI-based application designed to detect synthetic identity fraud, a growing threat in consumer lending. This launch aligns with a broader industry trend where financial services are increasingly adopting AI for fraud detection, risk management, and operational efficiency, as highlighted by Nvidia's "State of AI in Financial Services" report.

feed.title: Philip Morris International Urges FDA Advisory Committee to Recommend Authorizing ZYN as a Modified Risk Tobacco Product

feed.title: Clorox buys maker of Purell for $2.25 billion in ‘compelling combination’

Gojo Industries, a privately owned company with nearly $800 million in annual sales, primarily operates through business-to-business sales.

feed.summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM) recently announced a $26 million investment to expand its Erlanger, Kentucky facility for natural color and flavor solutions, reinforcing its focus on cleaner-label ingredients and healthy consumer preferences. While this aligns with ADM's long-term strategy to pivot towards value-added ingredients and was accompanied by FORTUNE recognition, it's unlikely to significantly impact near-term financials given the company's large revenue and current margin compressions. Investors should consider short-term catalysts like updates on the ADM Investor Services sale, cost controls, and management's stance on buybacks, alongside the current high valuation and persistent margin pressures.

feed.title: ELI LILLY & CO (NYSE:LLY) Offers a Durable Dividend with Strong Growth and Financial Health
feed.summary: Eli Lilly & Co (LLY) is presented as a strong candidate for income-oriented investors due to its notable dividend, robust financial health, and consistent growth. The company boasts a high ChartMill Dividend Rating of 7/10, supported by a decade of increasing payouts, a manageable 28.3% payout ratio, and strong profitability. While its current yield is modest, its significant stock price gains and growth prospects make it an appealing long-term dividend investment.

feed.title: Here's What Mizuho Securities Has to Say About ​Palo Alto Networks (PANW)
feed.summary: Mizuho Securities reiterated a Buy rating on Palo Alto Networks (PANW) with a $220 price target, following Guggenheim's upgrade to Neutral. The company is expected to see over 26.7% upside from current levels as it continues strategic acquisitions and provides essential security solutions.

feed.title: Experimental liver cirrhosis treatment falls short in Bausch RED-C trials
feed.summary: Bausch Health announced that its global Phase 3 RED-C program, testing amorphous-rifaximin SSD for the primary prevention of hepatic encephalopathy in adults with liver cirrhosis, did not meet its primary endpoint, despite the trials being safe and well-tolerated. The company's CEO, Thomas J. Appio, expressed disappointment but noted that the full dataset is being reviewed for potential new development opportunities. Bausch Health reiterated its commitment to hepatology and other therapeutic areas, acknowledging that no approved treatment currently exists for this patient population.

feed.title: Equifax uses AI to hunt fake borrowers costing lenders $13K each
feed.summary: Equifax has launched "Synthetic Identity Risk," an AI-powered fraud detection product designed to identify and prevent synthetic identity fraud. This new solution uses patent-pending machine learning to analyze identity data, credit history, and behavioral signals to detect fraud at account opening and continuously monitor portfolios. Equifax reports that synthetic identity fraud costs lenders an average of $13,000 per known case, highlighting the need for proactive prevention tools.

feed.summary: Motorola Solutions and Roper Technologies have experienced stock pullbacks from their 52-week highs, yet both show strong underlying business fundamentals. Roper Technologies, despite its stock dip, has solid sales growth, consistent dividend increases, and a new share repurchase authorization, demonstrating resilience and commitment to shareholder returns.

feed.title: US Commerce-assisted foreign contracts jump to $244 billion in 2025 on Boeing order gains
feed.summary: U.S. companies secured $244 billion in foreign government procurement contracts in 2025 with the help of the U.S. Commerce Department, nearly tripling the 2024 total. This significant increase was largely driven by a massive surge in Boeing jetliner orders, which rebounded to its sixth-best order year ever. The contracts, aided by foreign spending commitments in recent trade deals, are expected to support about 844,000 American jobs.

feed.title: Target Names Former Nike and HanesBrand Leaders to Board
feed.summary: Target Corp. has appointed John Hoke III, a veteran from Nike, and Steve Braspies, former CEO of HanesBrands, to its board of directors. These appointments are made as Target prepares for a new growth phase with incoming CEO Michael Fiddelke and aim to strengthen governance and strategy, leveraging the new board members' extensive experience in design, merchandising, and operations.

feed.title: Affera™ momentum continues as Medtronic announces CE Mark in Europe and U.S. IDE first cases for Sphere-360™ PFA catheter to treat paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
feed.summary: Medtronic announced that its Affera™ Sphere-360™ catheter has received CE Mark in Europe and successfully completed its first cases in the Horizon 360 IDE pivotal trial in the United States. This all-in-one mapping and single-shot pulsed field ablation (PFA) catheter is designed to treat paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (AFib) by conforming to pulmonary veins without rotation, enhancing efficiency and delivering consistent lesions. The Sphere-360 catheter aims to build on Medtronic's existing PFA offerings and provide a new, differentiated solution for AFib patients.

feed.title: FTAI Aviation stock price target raised to $335 from $230 at BTIG

The company has also launched FTAI Power to convert CFM56 engines into aeroderivative turbines for electricity, leading other analysts like Compass Point, RBC Capital, and Wolfe Research to also raise their price targets.

feed.title: Axogen (AXGN) prices stock offering and targets $69.7M term loan payoff

The company plans to use a significant portion of the net proceeds to pay off its term loan credit facility with Oberland Capital and affiliates, amounting to approximately $69.7 million, by February 15, 2026. This move will effectively replace the debt with equity capital, significantly altering Axogen's leverage profile.

feed.summary: Axogen (AXGN) has entered into an underwriting agreement with Wells Fargo Securities and Mizuho Securities USA to offer 4,000,000 shares of common stock at $31.00 per share. The bank is also navigating other legal and financial challenges while considering branch growth strategies.

feed.title: Exclusive | BlackRock and Trump ally Larry Fink look to make war-torn Ukraine great again
feed.summary: BlackRock, led by CEO Larry Fink, is in early-stage discussions with various governments, including sovereign wealth funds, to attract capital for Ukraine's reconstruction. The plan aims to seed an $800 billion fund, despite the ongoing war with Russia and existing challenges like corruption and population displacement. Fink, who is serving as the chairman of the World Economic Forum in Davos, is reportedly close to both President Trump and Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky, both of whom are also attending the forum.

feed.title: Arqit Launches Encryption Intelligence for Post-Quantum Cryptography Planning

This tool identifies encryption assets, legacy algorithms, and deprecated protocols across various environments to reduce migration risk. Arqit's approach aligns with regulatory guidance, and the company is participating in the UK NCSC Post-Quantum Cryptography Pilot to validate its methodology.

feed.title: SLB beats quarterly profit estimates on strong North America activity

This strategic shift is redefining how the company competes, grows, and manages risk, leading to a diversified pipeline and a balanced approach to market challenges compared to its rivals. The company's unique strategy of combining high-value franchises with a platform-like approach to innovation has positioned it for continued growth and has led to a premium valuation in the market.
